title: Zahra Tere Bachchon ka Koi Apna Nahin Hai
body:
Rowain To Dilasa Bhi Koi Deta Nahin Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Darbar Kya Hai Fizza Ye Zainab Ko Batana (x2)
Tu Dekh Chuki Is Nay Abhi Dekha Nahin Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Paani Ki Jaga Utra Hai Kyun Halq Mein Paikan (x2)
Pyasa Tau Kabhi Apna Lahoo Peeta Nahin Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Awaaz Ki Jaanib Voh Ba Andaza Chalay Hain (x2)
Akbar Teray Baba Ko Tho Kuch Dikhta Nahin Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Pani Pila Do So Nay Ko Hai Zahra Ka Beta (x2)
Pani Piyay Baghair Yeh Kabhi Sota Nahin Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Dur Cheen Chuka Looti Rida Aag Lagayee (x2)
Lekin Kyun Abhi Shimr Ka Ji Bharta Nahin Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo Log Is Hisar Mein Bachchon Ko Dekhtay (x2)
Kya Eik Musalman Ka Bhi Dil Dukhta Nahin Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Yeh Baat Munkashif Huwi Karbal Mein Salamat (x2)
Bin Ishq-e-Khuda Maqtal Kabhi Sajta Nahin Hai
